title: Instantly AI Pricing 2026: Plans and Real Monthly Cost
summary: Instantly AI pricing starts at $25/month with three main plans. Compare features and costs to determine which tier fits your email volume and budget.
body_markdown:
## Instantly AI pricing today and what it covers


### What Instantly's listed price actually buys


Pay the listed price and you have bought the software only.


Instantly sells cold email software on tiered monthly plans. **The email accounts you send from, the domains behind them and the contact lists are bought separately, so the sticker price understates the bill.** Even teams that wire the tool into their wider workflow, perhaps through an automation builder like[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) , still pay for those pieces on top.


> **The email accounts you send from, the domains behind them and the contact lists are bought separately, so the sticker price understates the bill.


Think of a quote that covers the lumber but not the labor. It's accurate, and it'll still surprise you at the end. Plan names and prices are on the vendor's pricing page, and the sections below price what sits around them.


### What Instantly sells and how it bills


Connect email accounts, load a list of prospects, write a sequence of messages, and the software sends them on a schedule and tracks replies. That is what Instantly, a cold email outreach platform, does.


Cold email means writing to people who haven't asked to hear from you, which is why the sending setup matters as much as the software.


### How Instantly billing and subscriptions work


You pay a recurring subscription, with higher tiers raising your limits on how much you can send and store. Other products, such as lead data, are priced on their own meters. The extras may not show up on the card you compare first.


### How to read a pricing page


Almost every vendor lays out pricing the same way. Activepieces does too: its pricing page runs from a free plan at $0, through Plus at $20 and Team at $200 a month, to Ultimate, which is a custom quote, with feature rows underneath.


Read the rows, not the headline price, because the limits on each row are what you outgrow first. The screenshot below shows that layout.


Next come the figures behind the rest of this article, and where they came from.


### Sources for the Instantly pricing figures


Before any number appears, know where it came from: every[Instantly](https://instantly.ai/pricing.md) figure in this article was read from instantly.ai/pricing on 2 November 2026. Vendors change plans and prices without notice, so check the live page before you commit.


Where I describe a cost that sits outside the plan, such as domains or lead data, I say so, and I don't fold it into the plan price.
